Gardener’s Delight Soil Mix
Having experimented with numerous soil mixes, I can state that
Gardener’s Delight Soil Mix is a superior product. While pricier
than some, it has substantially enhanced my campus garden plot.
My plants grow more quickly thanks to the nutrient-rich
composition. No amendments required, so application is simple.
